📖 Common Data for Linked Questions (Centrifugal Pumping Station — Q = 50 L/s) Shared ID: PSG_287554D847C6 · Question 1 of 3

Common Data Passage: A municipal water pumping station uses a centrifugal pump of overall efficiency η=75% to lift water (ρ=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2) at a steady discharge of Q=50 L/s through a uniform delivery pipe of internal diameter D=200 mm against a total manometric head of H=25 m.

Based on the shared pumping-station data above, what is the average flow velocity of water inside the 200 mm delivery pipe?

A
1.59 m/s
✓ Correct
B
0.4 m/s
C
3.18 m/s
D
2.74 m/s
View Explanation & Provenance (Answer: Option A)

Converting volumetric flow rate to SI units gives Q=50×10-3=0.05 m3/s. For pipe internal diameter D=0.20 m (radius r=0.10 m), cross-sectional area is A=πr2=0.031416 m2. By the continuity equation, mean velocity V=Q/A=1.59 m/s. Distractor B arises if diameter is mistakenly squared without dividing by 4.

📖 Common Data for Linked Questions (Centrifugal Pumping Station — Q = 40 L/s) Shared ID: PSG_C8A6E853FA22 · Question 3 of 3

Common Data Passage: A municipal water pumping station uses a centrifugal pump of overall efficiency η=80% to lift water (ρ=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2) at a steady discharge of Q=40 L/s through a uniform delivery pipe of internal diameter D=200 mm against a total manometric head of H=30 m.

Using the shared pumping-station data (η=80%), determine the mechanical shaft power required from the driving electric motor.

A
11.77 kW
B
9.42 kW
C
14.71 kW
✓ Correct
D
18.39 kW
View Explanation & Provenance (Answer: Option C)

Overall pump efficiency relates useful hydraulic output power to mechanical shaft input power via η=Phyd/Pshaft. Substituting Phyd=11.77 kW and η=0.80 yields Pshaft=11.770.80=14.71 kW. Option B is the classic student trap of multiplying instead of dividing by efficiency.

📖 Common Data for Linked Questions (Centrifugal Pumping Station — Q = 40 L/s) Shared ID: PSG_C8A6E853FA22 · Question 2 of 3

Common Data Passage: A municipal water pumping station uses a centrifugal pump of overall efficiency η=80% to lift water (ρ=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2) at a steady discharge of Q=40 L/s through a uniform delivery pipe of internal diameter D=200 mm against a total manometric head of H=30 m.

Referring to the same pumping station passage, what is the useful hydraulic (water) power imparted to the fluid by the pump?

A
1.2 kW
B
11.77 kW
✓ Correct
C
14.71 kW
D
9.42 kW
View Explanation & Provenance (Answer: Option B)

Useful hydraulic power delivered directly to the water stream depends purely on specific weight, discharge, and manometric head: Phyd=ρgQH=1000×9.81×0.04×30 W = 11.77 kW. Option C represents shaft input power, whereas Option D wrongly multiplies hydraulic power by efficiency.
